purpose: Default stage-5 search space for the Calyx EA pipeline (see PIPELINE.md). A study copies the dimensions that apply to its logic into its own run-config and records every configuration tried.

data_split.development: available history before the older pre-OOS validation window
data_split.validation: 12 months immediately BEFORE the final two-year OOS; finalist selection only here
data_split.holdout: always last TWO calendar years ending at the frozen study end-exclusive date; final candidate used once
data_split.recent_1y_6m_3m: diagnostic OOS subwindows only; never tune/select on them

dimensions.session_utc_note: Exness server clock is UTC; New York windows follow US DST. Asia 00:00-08:00 UTC, London 07:00-16:00 UTC, New York 13:30-20:00 UTC (DST-adjusted), overlap 12:00-16:00 UTC unless the study defines otherwise.

procedure.search: staged: timeframe -> entry -> stop type -> stop management -> RR/exit -> session -> direction -> filters -> management; keep top 3 per stage
procedure.plateau_check: joint small grid around finalists; neighbours must stay profitable
procedure.ranking: development PF and return/drawdown with minimum trade counts, never return alone

monte_carlo.cost_stress: measured extra spread/slippage per trade only
monte_carlo.prop_firm_sim: FTMO phase 1/2 pass and breach probabilities, days to pass
monte_carlo.portfolio_overlap: correlation and marginal effect vs current portfolio
